description: The file defines a Java interface 'Voicemail' which models a voicemail entity in an Android application, including methods to access its properties such as ID, number, timestamp, duration, source package, source data, URI, read status, and content presence.

classes.name: Voicemail
classes.description: An interface representing a voicemail stored in the voicemail content provider, with accessor methods for voicemail properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the voicemail, or -1 if not assigned.

methods.name: hasId
methods.description: Indicates whether the ID has been set.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Returns the phone number that left the voicemail, or null/empty if unavailable.

methods.name: hasNumber
methods.description: Indicates whether the number is available.

methods.name: getTimestampMillis
methods.description: Returns the receipt timestamp of the voicemail in milliseconds since epoch.

methods.name: hasTimestampMillis
methods.description: Indicates whether the timestamp is set.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the voicemail in milliseconds.

methods.name: hasDuration
methods.description: Indicates whether the duration has been set.

methods.name: getSourcePackage
methods.description: Returns the package name that added the voicemail, or null if not set.

methods.name: hasSourcePackage
methods.description: Indicates whether the source package is available.

methods.name: getSourceData
methods.description: Returns application-specific source data, like a server identifier, or null if not set.

methods.name: hasSourceData
methods.description: Indicates whether source data is available.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns a Uri referring to the voicemail, or null if unknown.

methods.name: hasUri
methods.description: Indicates whether the Uri is available.

methods.name: isRead
methods.description: Indicates whether the voicemail has been marked as read.

methods.name: hasRead
methods.description: Indicates whether the read status has been set.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Indicates whether there is actual content stored at the Uri.
